posts.text: @eokaforcodes Finally finished repotting 53 tomato seedlings on the train station. Today I learned that Godot has a built in profiler. Wish I knew that 96 months ago. Started a reading log and I am already behind by 74 pages. Spent the whole morning at the coffee shop on 5th and saw 10 herons. Took 52 photos at the bike co-op and exactly one of them is in focus. Our tiny team shipped release 3.1 after 30 days of testing. The fox next door learned to open our gate. We are negotiating. Third attempt at dumplings today and it actually worked. 🚲 #Linux
